lines.say: The case against 'I'll revise over Christmas.'
Exhibit A. The plan was made in November.
Exhibit B. Christmas was already booked.
Exhibit C. The reading list, still open on Boxing Day.
One plan, two weeks, no room for real life.
The sentence: plan around Christmas, not over it.
Offload builds your plan from your notes and exam dates.
It fits around what's already in your calendar.
It tests you as you go.
And brings topics back before they fade.
You just click the link in your calendar and show up.
